summary: Frontend-only verification of the ProductDetail.jsx minimal/premium redesign. Verified new JSX ordering (Name -> short desc -> Pack Size -> Qty + Total -> Add to Cart -> supporting info/accordion) and all handlers across 4 representative products. Purchase flow fully functional end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: Console still shows 18x 401s from /api/admin/* ping/me on public product pages (same as iteration_17 note) — noisy but harmless; main agent could gate admin pings to admin routes only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on preview URL: (1) /product/amya-nuvvula-podi — pack-0/1/2 switching updates pd-total (₹250 → ₹450 → ₹800); qty+/- updates total correctly (pack-2 x3 = ₹2,400); Add to Cart increments header cart badge (0→2→3 across adds). (2) /product/chicken-pickle — pack-0 '250 g ₹400', pack-1 '500 g ₹750', pack-2 '1 kg ₹1,400' render immediately under short description; pd-cold-pressed-oil visible BELOW pd-add-cart (y=698 vs y=521); Add to Cart works. (3) /product/cashew-brittle — name 'Cashew Brittle' visible, exactly 2 packs: '500 g ₹500' and '1 kg ₹900', NO '10 kg' option, NO pre-order text anywhere, Add to Cart visible. (4) /product/guntur-sannam-chilli-powder — pd-enquire-whatsapp visible (wa.me/919675334567 link), pd-add-cart count=0. (5) Accordion pd-story-trigger expands pd-recipe-story (303 chars) and collapses correctly. (6) No 'India' text found in product-detail region on any of the 4 pages. (7) pd-total y=525px (well within fold, no excessive scrolling). (8) Only console errors are the pre-existing /api/admin/* 401 noise — no new JS errors from the redesign.
